You are being evaluated on Continual-ARC, a lifelong stream of ARC-style grid puzzles.
Each puzzle instance has a task id and a test input grid. Tasks recur across the
stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object
on the last line of your reply:
  {"action": "submit", "grid": [[0, 1, 2], [3, 4, 5]]}   submit an output grid
  {"action": "request_demos"}                            ask for one more demonstration pair for this task
  {"action": "finish"}                                   end the instance, once it is over
Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

Scoring: every wrong submission costs 1 and every demo request costs 1. An
instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt cap is reached, and
reaching the cap is charged the full cap. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

n=27
G=[[4]*n for _ in range(n)]
for r in range(n): G[r][13]=1
for c in range(n): G[13][c]=1
# TL motif and target 2 objects
for r in (3,4):
    for c in (3,4): G[r][c]=3
    for c in (5,6): G[r][c]=6
for r in (5,6):
    for c in (1,2,3,4): G[r][c]=8
    for c in (5,6): G[r][c]=2
for r in (7,8):
    for c in (5,6): G[r][c]=1
# TR 3x3 target
for r in range(4,7):
    for c in range(19,22): G[r][c]=2
# BL singleton
G[21][5]=2
# BR 4x4 target
for r in range(19,23):
    for c in range(18,22): G[r][c]=2
# apply macroblock template, source anchor (r=5:7,c=5:7), tile size 2; quadrants TR, BR, BL
# offsets (in source 2x2 tiles): color3 (-1,-1), color6(-1,0), color8(0,-2),(0,-1), color1(+1,0)
# mapping sign by quadrant; generate patches with cropping to quadrant boundaries and grid
def paint_tile(r0,c0,k,color, q):
    # q is row/col orientation signs for source template offsets
    rlo,rhi=(0,12) if r0<13 else (14,26)
    clo,chi=(0,12) if c0<13 else (14,26)
    for r in range(max(r0,rlo,0), min(r0+k,rhi+1,n)):
        for c in range(max(c0,clo,0), min(c0+k,chi+1,n)):
            G[r][c]=color

def add_pattern(anchor_r,anchor_c,k, row_sign, col_sign):
    # Anchor top-left at anchor_r,c. source anchor macro tile top-left (block index 1,2)
    for color, dr,dc in [(3,-1,-1),(6,-1,0),(8,0,-2),(8,0,-1),(1,1,0)]:
        tr=anchor_r + row_sign*dr*k
        tc=anchor_c + col_sign*dc*k
        paint_tile(tr,tc,k,color,None)
add_pattern(4,19,3,1,-1) # TR
add_pattern(19,18,4,-1,-1) # BR
add_pattern(21,5,1,-1,1) # BL
print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,row)) for row in G))
